description: SeedData.thread map is keyed by logical names (thread-alpha, plain-simple, etc.) but the doc comment on SeedData says only 'Logical name -> assigned thread Id' without explaining the naming convention. It is not obvious that single-email fixtures get a thread entry under the same name as the email, while multi-email threads use a separate name ('thread-alpha'). A contributor adding a new thread fixture will not know which convention to follow. Document the naming rules on SeedData.thread.
title: seed.rs: email-fixture to thread mapping undocumented in return struct
